title: HashiCorp Terraform Cloud/Enterprise User token: one-property twin (length)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 66-byte suffix segment vs the provider-documented 67. Twin of "HashiCorp Terraform Cloud/Enterprise Organization token, HashiCorp Terraform Cloud/Enterprise Team token and 1 more: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of terraform-cloud-token-user-shape-bare: length: 66-byte suffix segment vs the provider-documented 67. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
